subject: Moogle
text: Touching the robot-like enemy can inflict the Moogle condition, dropping defense to 0 and causing the player to take large damage from enemies.

evidence.quote: If you accidentally touched it, it may inflict the Moogle condition at you. During this time, your defense will drop to 0 and you will receive a very large amount of damage from enemies.

subject: Weapon Shop
text: The Weapon Shop sells Opal Equipments, which provide much higher defense than Gold equipment.

evidence.quote: Move on until you see the Weapon Shop. If you have the money, go and buy the Opal Equipments. They are very strong in defense compared to the Gold ones.

subject: Mt. Rocks North Door
text: To open the north door, place all 4 treasure chests on the 4 floor tiles and then attack one of the chests.

evidence.quote: In here, you have to put all 4 treasure chests on the 4 tiles on the ground. If you accidentally destroyed a chest, leave the room and come back again. After placing the 4 chests the door to the north won’t open right? To open the door, just attack one of the 4 chests and the door will open (I don’t know why it should be this way).

subject: Cyclops
text: Cyclops yields 70 EXP and 64 GP upon defeat, and his preferred weapon weakness is the Chain.

subject: Cyclops
text: Stay above or below Cyclops and attack him continually, as he only attacks horizontally.

evidence.quote: Just stay above or below him and keep on attacking him. Just make sure that you are out of the way of his attacks. He will only attack horizontally which will be very predictable.

subject: Morning Star
text: Defeating the Cyclops reveals a chest containing the Morning Star, which can be equipped immediately.

evidence.quote: After beating the Cyclops, you’ll see a chest appear in the middle. It’s the dreaded Morning Star!...After getting it, equip it right away.

subject: Morning Star
text: The Morning Star can destroy walls and blocking rocks, replacing the need for Mattocks.

evidence.quote: You can also dump or sell your Mattocks as the Morning Star can destroy walls. You can also destroy rocks that block your way.

subject: Golem
text: Golem yields 98 EXP and 173 GP, and requires fighting with the Morning Star only.

evidence.quote: BOSS: GOLEM...EXP gained:         98...GP:                 173...Preferred Weapon:   Morning Star Only!

subject: Golem
text: Defeating Golem awards the Magic book of Lightning (lit).

evidence.quote: After beating Golem, you will receive the Magic book of Lightning (lit).

subject: Bridge
text: Entering the cave causes the bridge outside to collapse, permanently preventing return.

evidence.quote: When you enter the cave, you’ll see the bridge collapse. You can’t go back anymore.

subject: Chimera
text: Chimera awards 20 EXP and 91 GP, with the Morning Star as the preferred weapon.

evidence.quote: BOSS: CHIMERA...EXP gained:         20...GP:                 91...Preferred Weapon:   Morning Star

subject: Chain Switch Puzzle
text: Grapple to the northern pole with the Chain, grapple to the left pole when the Will Bar fills, step on the switch to reveal a ladder, and grapple to the southern pole.

evidence.quote: Here, equip your Chain. Now, use the chain first on the northern most pole. Now wait until your Will Bar fills up, then use the chain on the left pole. Now, step on the switch. A ladder will appear on the lower right corner of the room. Now, wait again until your Will Bar fills up and then use it on the southern most pole. Now, use the ladder.

subject: Werewolf Room Ladder
text: In the Werewolf room, avoid hitting any of the 4 chests or the ladder will disappear.

evidence.quote: All you have to do here is to prevent hitting the 4 chests. If you accidentally hit a chest, the ladder will disappear, so you have to leave the room and come back again.

subject: Blood Sword Chest
text: Defeat all the Knights in the room to open the chest containing the Blood Sword.

evidence.quote: After beating all the Knights in this room, get the chest for the Blood Sword.

subject: Snowman Switch Puzzle
text: Use Ice Magic to freeze two knights into Snowmen and place them onto the 2 floor switches to make a ladder appear.

evidence.quote: In this room, there are 2 floor switches. You have to use your Ice Magic to turn the knights into Snowmen. Note that the Black Mages here cannot be turned to snowmen. If there’s only one knight, leave the room and then come back again until you see 2 knights. Now, turn them into Snowmen and put them on the 2 switches. After you’ve put the 2 snowmen on the switches, a ladder will appear on the lower right corner.

subject: EXP Grinding
text: To grind EXP, defeat the Dark Mages and Knights in the throne room, save, soft reset the Game Boy by pressing A, B, Start, and Select simultaneously, and reload.

evidence.quote: The Dark Mages and the Knights give off a fair amount of EXP. So, beat all of them inside the throne room and then save. And then, reset your Gameboy by pressing A,B,Start and Select buttons AT THE SAME TIME. Now, load your game again. Do this pattern until you level up or up to how many times you want.

subject: Dark Lord
text: Dark Lord grants 166 EXP and 11 GP upon defeat, and his preferred weapon weakness is the Morning Star.

evidence.quote: BOSS: DARK LORD...EXP gained:         166...GP:                 11...Preferred Weapon:   Morning Star

subject: Dark Lord
text: Attacking with the Morning Star will pass directly through Dark Lord's shield to damage him.

evidence.quote: All you have to do is to use your Morning Star. It will pass through his shield and damage him.
